content.title: Use the publish-your-book CTA on a published book detail page to reach /publish
content.intent: Prove that the book-detail-page conversion CTA routes the reader from a valid book page into the publishing packages page.
content.technique_notes: Derived from REQ-08's routing promise for the detail-page CTA. Techniques: equivalence partitioning over resource state {existing published book}; happy-path navigation. Kept separate from the content-inspection scenario because activating the CTA changes the page outcome and proves a distinct propagation promise. No covering array applied: the source specifies no independent input dimensions to combine; the risk-judged interaction strength would have been 2 because no money, auth, or data-loss factor applies.
